title: 4-layer DC coupon (JLC04161H-7628)

assumptions: layer positions as published for JLC04161H-7628 (the microsection measures them)

drill convention: the drill file's via sizes are finished holes (the fabs' standard; FAB_NOTES asks for them as drawn), but pdnsim's barrel (either via model) reads the board's drill as the drilled outer-barrel diameter (A = π·t·(d − t), docs/PHYSICS.md §3). If the hole is finished as drawn, the real barrel resistance differs from prediction (a)'s by 0.30 mm -11.3 %, 0.50 mm -6.9 % (−2t/(d + t) at 18 µm); (a) via errors of that size are this convention, not the via model; (b) uses the microsection's wall and finished hole and is immune

ENIG on every mask-free pad (nickel 3–6 µm, IPC-4552): the board thickness is read with a micrometer contact ≤ 2.5 mm centred on each 3 × 3 mm thickness island (docs/CORRELATION.md §3), so the reading includes the finish of both faces (+6–12 µm, ≤ 0.8 % of the span; not subtracted); a flat 6.35–8 mm anvil would also rest on the mask-covered pour and the silkscreen around the island (+10–80 µm, 0.6–5 %) and is not a valid reading; the vias are covered (tented or plugged; no finish in the barrels): DC-B is ordered Plugged (insulating mask ink in the barrels; JLCPCB's 4-layer form has no Tented); JLCPCB does not ink-plug a via it finds within 0.35 mm of a pad and decides how to cover it, so the PCB Remark asks for such vias to be tented, never epoxy- or copper-filled or left open (checked at Confirm Production File and recorded per via on the microsection); the ink does not change the barrel copper

sources.value: Cu 0.035 / 7628 prepreg 0.2104 / Cu 0.0152 / core 1.065 / Cu 0.0152 / 7628 prepreg 0.2104 / Cu 0.035 mm, identical to the 'No requirement' 1.6 mm 4-layer stackup; 'The PCB will be strictly produced in accordance with the following stackup'
'for an inner layer of 0.5 oz, the thickness provided by the supplier is 0.0175 mm … an actual thickness of 0.0152 mm is more accurate'

'1oz copper = copper thickness of 35 µm' and 0.035 mm outer copper in every published stackup; the impedance-design table gives 'Outer Layer Finished Copper Thickness (1 oz) 1.6 mil' (40.6 µm): 35 µm is used, the crosses measure the real value

ENIG ordered (a surcharge: 'ENIG is no longer offered as a free surface finish option', news of 2026-07-30). OSP is not: the quote form says OSP is 'Not supported for castellated/press-fit holes, plated blind slots, or physical contact areas (e.g., gold fingers, keypads)', and every kit pad is a spring-probe contact area (DECISIONS D170)
'Nickel thickness: approximately 3-6 micrometers; JLCPCB offers gold thicknesses of 1 or 2 microinches'
'Vias are treated differently from pads … Vias don't have a specified tolerance whereas pad through-holes are +0.13/-0.08 mm'; tented vias 'no larger than 0.5 mm'
'The Via Tented option is upgraded to Via Plugged for free' (the quote form offers no Tented on 4 layers)

'Single-sided or double-sided vias, holes in pad, and vias with a distance less than 0.35mm from the pad cannot be plugged with ink. Such vias can be plugged with epoxy or copper.' The page does not say from which edge the 0.35 mm is measured, so JLCPCB decides which DC-B vias it cannot ink-plug; the PCB Remark asks for those to be tented, never filled (epoxy or copper would change the measured barrels)
